title: qwkit: quantum-well intersubband optics toolkit
description: Validated Python toolkit for quantum-well intersubband optics: self-consistent Schrodinger-Poisson states with nonparabolicity and depolarisation, LO-phonon scattering rates, density-matrix second-order susceptibility, multilevel saturation, planar waveguide modes, electrode fields and coupled-mode second-harmonic propagation with quasi-phase matching.
